trigger: User wants to create a new AI node on a single hive with no topology changes needed.
constraints: runtime field in node must exactly match the runtime name (no @hive suffix)
runtime version must be a semver string like '0.1.0'
ownership must be 'solution' for user-created nodes
do_not_repeat: do not add topology section if no new hive or VPN is needed
do not duplicate the runtime in nodes — nodes reference runtimes by name
do not set package_source to 'pre_published' unless the runtime already exists and is materialized

trigger: User wants a node on a worker hive and a routing rule so messages flow to it from a motherbee agent, the two isolated in their own VPN.
constraints: a VPN rule is SY.config.routes' rule: hive, pattern, match_kind (EXACT, PREFIX or GLOB) and a numeric vpn_id; it puts the nodes of that hive whose names match into that VPN
nodes reach only nodes of their own VPN (system nodes excepted): give the specialist and the motherbee agent that calls it the same vpn_id
route prefix must end with a dot (e.g., 'AI.specialist.' not 'AI.specialist')
next_hop_hive in routing must match the hive_id of the target hive exactly
do_not_repeat: do not add topology.hives for motherbee — it always exists
do not declare a VPN rule unless the request asks to isolate nodes: a node left out of it can no longer reach the nodes in it
do not set next_hop_hive to a hive where the node does not live

trigger: User wants to deploy a workflow on an existing hive.

definition.description: Asks IO.quickbooks for an invoice and waits for the validated data.

states.name: collecting_data
states.description: Asks for the invoice and waits for its data.

constraints: declare only the workflow: SY.wf-rules packages it and creates and runs its node, WF.<workflow_name>@<hive>
workflow_name is lowercase letters, digits and '-' in dot-separated parts, each starting with a letter, and unique per hive
the definition is a wf_schema_version 1 state machine: workflow_type, input_schema, initial_state, terminal_states, and states with entry_actions, exit_actions and transitions (CEL guards)
do_not_repeat: do not declare the WF node in nodes, nor a runtime for it: SY.wf-rules makes both
do not put the workflow definition content inside a node config — it goes in wf_deployments
do not deploy a workflow on an ingress or egress hive: it has no SY.wf-rules
